request.project_task: Build an online symptom triage and appointment routing service.
request.project_goal: Route non-emergency requests while identifying cases needing urgent help.
request.project_description: A patient answers questions; the service gives a routing recommendation and schedules eligible requests.

functional_requirements.text: A patient selects a symptom category.

atoms.text: A patient selects a symptom category.

functional_requirements.text: The system displays an emergency warning when configured red flags are present.

atoms.text: The system displays an emergency warning when configured red flags are present.

functional_requirements.text: The system recommends a care route for non-emergency answers.

atoms.text: The system recommends a care route for non-emergency answers.

functional_requirements.text: The patient books an offered appointment.

atoms.text: The patient books an offered appointment.

functional_requirements.text: A clinician reviews submitted answers before the appointment.

atoms.text: A clinician reviews submitted answers before the appointment.

functional_requirements.text: The patient can correct answers before clinician review.

atoms.text: The patient can correct answers before clinician review.

non_functional_requirements.text: The service must state that its output is not a diagnosis.
The requirements do not provide the red-flag rule set.
Sensitive answers must be accessible only to the patient and assigned clinician.

actors.name: Patient
actors.description: A person seeking non-emergency symptom triage and appointment routing.

actors.name: Clinician
actors.description: A healthcare professional who reviews submitted answers before the appointment.

use_cases.name: Complete Symptom Triage
use_cases.goal: Patient answers symptom questions and receives a routing recommendation or emergency warning.
use_cases.trigger: Patient starts a symptom triage session.

preconditions.text: Patient has access to the service.

success_postconditions.text: Patient has received a care route recommendation or emergency warning.

failure_postconditions.text: Triage session is incomplete or abandoned.

steps.action: System evaluates answers for configured red flags.
System recommends a care route for non-emergency answers.
System displays an emergency warning when configured red flags are present.

user_stories.capability: select a symptom category and answer questions
user_stories.benefit: receive a care route recommendation or emergency warning

system_stories.system_action: Evaluate answers for configured red flags.
system_stories.responsibility: Detect emergency conditions based on red flag rules.

system_stories.system_action: Recommend a care route for non-emergency answers.
system_stories.responsibility: Provide routing recommendation based on triage answers.

missing_information.description: The red-flag rule set is not provided.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Complete Symptom Triage
Goal: Patient answers symptom questions and receives a routing recommendation or emergency warning.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Patient starts a symptom triage session.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: Patient has access to the service.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Patient selects a symptom category.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] Patient answers category-specific questions.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] System evaluates answers for configured red flags.
  4. [STEP-UC001-004] System recommends a care route for non-emergency answers.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: Emergency red flag detected
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-004

use_cases.trigger: Patient chooses to book an offered appointment.

preconditions.text: Patient has received a care route recommendation.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Book Appointment
Goal: Patient books an offered appointment.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Patient chooses to book an offered appointment.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: Patient has received a care route recommendation.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Patient books an offered appointment.
Source FRs: FR-005

use_cases.name: Review Submitted Answers
use_cases.goal: Clinician reviews submitted answers before the appointment.
use_cases.trigger: Clinician accesses submitted answers before an appointment.

preconditions.text: Patient has submitted answers and an appointment is scheduled.

failure_postconditions.text: Clinician cannot access or review answers.

steps.action: Clinician reviews submitted answers before the appointment.

user_stories.capability: review submitted answers before the appointment

system_stories.system_action: Provide submitted answers to the clinician.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure clinician can access patient answers.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Review Submitted Answers

Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: Clinician accesses submitted answers before an appointment.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: Patient has submitted answers and an appointment is scheduled.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] Clinician reviews submitted answers before the appointment.
Source FRs: FR-006

use_cases.name: Correct Answers
use_cases.goal: Patient corrects answers before clinician review.
use_cases.trigger: Patient chooses to correct previously submitted answers.

preconditions.text: Patient has submitted answers and clinician review has not occurred.

steps.action: Patient can correct answers before clinician review.

system_stories.system_action: Allow patient to edit submitted answers.
system_stories.responsibility: Enable answer correction before clinician review.

Use Case: UC-004 — Correct Answers
Goal: Patient corrects answers before clinician review.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Patient chooses to correct previously submitted answers.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC004-001: Patient has submitted answers and clinician review has not occurred.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC004-001] Patient can correct answers before clinician review.
Source FRs: FR-007
